result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days, not the 180-day figure.

The fix is one line in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportOverviewSection.java` (line 120, in `addBigRepositoriesSummary`). The LOC text was formatting `loc180Days` instead of `loc90Days`. The repository count and percentage already used the 90-day values, so they are unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o -pl reports test`, which finished with no errors. I did not add a test for this block, and I did not commit.
